title: PowerToys运行时ALT键松发BUG问题：Alt 物理按下不触发，物理松开立刻触发按下与松开
author: x123ly
summary: Grab and Move is reported to suppress Alt keydown and replay Alt keydown/keyup on release; current duplicate evidence points to the newer trigger-key soft-lock thread with diagnostics.

status.label: Consolidate with active Grab and Move soft-lock issue
status.detail: The same KeyUp-only/trigger-key soft-lock pattern is tracked in Issue 50248, with related Alt interception evidence in Issue 49037.

next_action.label: Post consolidation comment
next_action.reason: Keep the low-level hook evidence in the newer diagnostic thread instead of opening a parallel design.

judgment.rationale: Issue 50248 reports the same Grab and Move trigger-key soft-lock/KeyUp-only behavior and includes a diagnostic archive; Issue 49037 tracks related Alt interception conflicts. This issue adds a FancyZones co-enabled observation but no diagnostic ZIP or distinct confirmed root cause.
evidence: The report says physical Alt down is not delivered and Alt keydown/keyup arrive together on release with near-zero duration.
The reporter states uninstalling or disabling Grab and Move removes the Alt-key problem.
Issue 50248 reports Grab and Move leaving Alt/Win shortcuts unusable with online keyboard tests seeing only KeyUp, and includes diagnostics.
Issue 49037 reports Grab and Move blocking Alt behavior in PowerShell and desktop drag scenarios.
Focused code inspection of src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp found an intentional low-level hook path that absorbs configured modifier keydown and conditionally replays it.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a consolidation comment directing follow-up to Issue 50248 while noting the FancyZones co-enabled detail as potentially distinct evidence.

issue_context.summary: The Chinese-language report describes Alt entering an input-state split while Grab and Move and FancyZones are enabled: physical Alt remains down according to GetAsyncKeyState, but delivered keyboard messages show the press only when the key is released.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2211.0 Preview from Microsoft Store is reported.
Grab and Move is identified by the reporter as the on/off switch for the symptom.
FancyZones was also enabled when the reporter observed the race-like behavior.
No PowerToys diagnostic ZIP was attached.
Issue 50248 and Issue 49037 are open and cover related Grab and Move modifier interception failures.
inferences: The reports likely share the configured-modifier absorption/replay path, but the FancyZones timing detail could still be an additional trigger rather than a separate root cause.
issue_context.analysis: The best current maintainer action is consolidation, not a new fix design, because a newer active issue has stronger diagnostic evidence for the same low-level hook symptom and the remaining distinction can be added there.
